accounts.signUp.title: Create an account
accounts.signUp.consentTerms: I agree to the Terms of Service and the Privacy Policy.
accounts.signUp.ageConfirm: I am at least {age} years old.
accounts.signUp.noRecoveryWarning: Your notes and highlights are encrypted with your password. If you forget it, only your recovery code can unlock them; we cannot reset it for you.
accounts.recoveryCode.title: Save your recovery code
accounts.recoveryCode.intro: This code is the only way to get your data back if you forget your password.
accounts.recoveryCode.warning: Store it somewhere safe and private. Anyone who has it can recover your account.
accounts.recoveryCode.confirmCharacter: To confirm you saved it, type these characters from your code.
accounts.recoveryCode.mismatch: Those characters do not match your code. Check it and try again.
accounts.signIn.title: Sign in
accounts.signIn.remember: Keep me signed in on this device
accounts.signIn.rememberHint: Only use this on a device you trust.
accounts.recover.title: Recover your account
accounts.recover.intro: Enter your email address, your recovery code and a new password.
accounts.recover.noCodeTitle: I don't have my recovery code
accounts.recover.startOverIntro: Without the code, your synced data cannot be decrypted. You can start over with an empty account.
accounts.recover.startOverWarning: Starting over permanently deletes the data stored on the server for this account.
accounts.recover.startOver: Email me a link to start over
accounts.recover.startOverSent: If an account exists for that address, an email is on its way.
accounts.accountPanel.title: Account
accounts.accountPanel.opaque: {n} items from a newer version are stored safely but not shown here.
accounts.accountPanel.signOutKeep: Sign out and keep syncing data on this computer
accounts.accountPanel.signOutWipe: Sign out and clear sync data on this computer
accounts.accountPanel.signOutWipeWarning: Your notes, highlights and other data on this computer are kept. Only the sync bookkeeping is cleared, so the next sign-in starts a fresh comparison. Anything not yet synced stays here.
accounts.changePassword.title: Change password
accounts.privacy.title: Privacy and your data
accounts.privacy.deleteWarning: This permanently deletes your account and everything stored on the server. It cannot be undone.
accounts.title: Account & sync
accounts.loadError: Account settings could not be loaded.
accounts.weakKeyring: This computer has no secure keyring, so your sign-in cannot be remembered safely. You will be asked for your password each time the app starts.
accounts.askEachLaunch: Ask for my password each time the app starts
accounts.server.title: Choose a sync server
accounts.server.label: Server address
accounts.server.hint: The address of the sync server you want to use, for example https://sync.example.org. Only https is accepted (http only for this computer).
accounts.serverUnreachable: The sync server cannot be reached right now.
accounts.networkBlocked: Sync needs web requests, and they are turned off. Allow web requests in the Privacy settings to sign in.
accounts.signupClosed: This server is not accepting new accounts.
accounts.unlock.title: Unlock sync
accounts.unverified: Your email address is not verified yet. Check your inbox for the verification link.
accounts.newCode.password: Enter your password to create a new recovery code
accounts.bnWarnings.title: {count, plural, one {# note file is not synced} other {# note files are not synced}}
accounts.bnWarnings.intro: These files are too large or cannot be read, so they stay on this computer only.
accounts.serverSees.1: Your email address, and when and how often you sync.
accounts.serverSees.2: How much encrypted data you store and how many devices you use.
accounts.serverSees.3: Nothing else: your notes, highlights and device names are encrypted on this computer before they are sent, so the server cannot read them.
accounts.error.bad_request: The request was not accepted. Check what you entered.
accounts.error.unauthorized: The email or password is not correct.
accounts.error.forbidden: That is not allowed for this account.
accounts.error.not_found: The server could not find that.
accounts.error.conflict_email: An account with that email address already exists.
accounts.error.too_large: That is too large to sync.
accounts.error.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
accounts.error.signup_closed: This server is not accepting new accounts.
accounts.error.server_error: The sync server had a problem. Try again later.
accounts.error.crypto: The stored keys could not be unlocked. Sign in again.
accounts.error.network: The sync server cannot be reached.
accounts.error.network_blocked: Web requests are turned off. Allow them in the Privacy settings.
accounts.feedback.straightRow: Straight rows of keys are easy to guess.
accounts.feedback.keyPattern: Short keyboard patterns are easy to guess.
accounts.feedback.simpleRepeat: Repeated characters like "aaa" are easy to guess.
accounts.feedback.extendedRepeat: Repeated patterns like "abcabcabc" are easy to guess.
accounts.feedback.sequences: Common sequences like "abc" are easy to guess.
accounts.feedback.recentYears: Recent years are easy to guess.
accounts.feedback.dates: Dates are often easy to guess.
accounts.feedback.topTen: This is one of the most used passwords.
accounts.feedback.topHundred: This is a very commonly used password.
accounts.feedback.common: This is a commonly used password.
accounts.feedback.similarToCommon: This is similar to a commonly used password.
accounts.feedback.wordByItself: A single word is easy to guess.
accounts.feedback.namesByThemselves: Single names or surnames are easy to guess.
accounts.feedback.commonNames: Common names and surnames are easy to guess.
accounts.feedback.userInputs: Do not use your email address or personal details.
accounts.feedback.pwned: This password appeared in a data breach.
accounts.feedback.l33t: Predictable substitutions like "@" for "a" do not help much.
accounts.feedback.reverseWords: Reversed words are not much harder to guess.
accounts.feedback.allUppercase: All capitals is almost as easy to guess as all lower case.
accounts.feedback.capitalization: Capitalizing the first letter does not help much.
accounts.feedback.dictionary: This is similar to a word that is easy to guess.
accounts.feedback.extraWords: Add more words that are less common.
accounts.feedback.useWords: Use a few words and avoid common phrases.
accounts.feedback.useLonger: Use a longer keyboard pattern with more turns.
accounts.feedback.noNeed: You can have a strong password without symbols, numbers or capitals.
accounts.feedback.associatedYears: Avoid years that are associated with you.
